paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.40% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.44%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.23%). Brent crude changed -6.08% to 109.62. Gold changed +0.53% to 4,029.1001. Bitcoin changed -1.01% to 79,974.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.17%) and Newmont (-4.59%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Bon Secours nears $6bn takeover of Bain-backed Surgery Partners (FT Markets). US hospital chain is the latest not-for-profit healthcare provider to seek a large deal Deals and capital markets: Marc Lore’s Wonder bets on Texas, automation and user-built restaurants as it mulls IPO (CNBC). Wonder is leaning into automation and user-built restaurants as founder Marc Lore prepares the startup for a potential IPO. Central banks and macro: Israeli central bank rejects Netanyahu’s plan to use crypto to evade sanctions (FT World). Critics say prime minister’s proposal would turn country into an economic pariah Geopolitics and trade: The right’s obsession with ‘civil war’ in Britain (FT World). Many of those stoking fears of bloody unrest don’t actually live in the country Geopolitics and trade: Mercuria challenging the ‘Dow Jones of shipping’ in court after Hormuz losses (FT Markets). Case will test the Baltic Exchange’s decision to keep publishing price estimates for shipping oil through the Strait of Hormuz during the war
